description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 02.04.2018 to 08.04.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the determination of new currency exchange rates for customs duties and charges by the Acting Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names an individual (H. P. Jayananda), it does so only to establish the authority making the regulatory determination and does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments that would trigger Types 1-3 classification.
